title: Youheidan no Ryouriban
synopsis: The story begins when Azuma Akari, a young man with an ambition to be a chef, trips into another world. Akari is picked up by Gangreve, the leader of a mercenary group. Each leader of the mercenary group is a quirky character, but Akari connects with them through his cooking.
